subject.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens

question: Should this PR wait for signed native behavior evidence, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate because secure Screen Recording and Keychain prompts blocked capture?
rationale: Tests and exact-head CI strongly cover the state machine, but they cannot demonstrate the user-visible timing in a real signed macOS session, and automation cannot safely decide whether the documented capture constraint warrants an override.

options.title: Require native proof
options.body: Run the signed app and provide a redacted recording or runtime trace showing no launch/auth banner and one offer on the first eligible inline-browser open.

options.title: Approve proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused tests, signed-build verification, and capture limitation as sufficient for this narrow timing change.

recommendation.title: Require native proof
recommendation.body: Run the signed app and provide a redacted recording or runtime trace showing no launch/auth banner and one offer on the first eligible inline-browser open.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the merged feature history and has the strongest context for arranging a signed native run, although final override authority remains with an authorized maintainer.
